name: University of Technology Sydney
description: The University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a public university in central Sydney, established as a university in 1988, with its campus in Ultimo next to the city centre. It is known for engineering, IT, business, design, health and communication.
whyIncluded: The Australian Government's indicative allocation lets UTS enrol about 5,350 new international students in 2026, a sign of strong international demand.

livingCosts.summary: UTS's own Sydney cost-of-living guide: a room in shared accommodation near UTS, food, public transport, utilities, phone and entertainment for 12 months, using the middle of each range UTS quotes. Excludes OSHC, tuition and set-up costs.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A: UTS international student guide 'Cost of living in Sydney' (canonical URL above; reached via /study/international/commencing-students/living-sydney/costs-living), read 2026-10-13. 'At a glance' table, 'Monthly cost (AUD)', figures based on Study Australia's cost of living calculator: accommodation $1,200-$3,400; food and groceries $400-$800; utilities and internet $150-$400; transport $130-$800; lifestyle and entertainment $350-$650; mobile phone plans $30-$100. The page also gives shared accommodation near UTS at $370-$550 a week. Housing = midpoint of the shared-accommodation range (A$460/week x 52/12 = 1,993.33), per the method's single-room rule; the monthly accommodation range (midpoint 2,300) covers whole dwellings and was not used. Food = midpoint 600; transport = midpoint 465; personal = utilities and internet midpoint 275 + lifestyle midpoint 500 + phone midpoint 65 = 840. Textbooks (A$400+, no period) excluded, as are OSHC, tuition and one-off set-up costs. Total about A$3,898/month (A$46,780/year), above the Home Affairs visa minimum of A$29,710.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.summary: 2027 tuition for international students for a full-time year (two sessions). Excludes the student services fee and overseas student health cover; UTS raises fees each calendar year.
programmes.notes: UTS course C09066 (CRICOS 084098A), '2027 International Undergraduate Course Summary Table' PDF on uts.edu.au ('Information is correct as of June 2026'), read 2026-10-13: 'Course Fee (A$/Session)' A$28,620 for 2027, course duration 8 sessions. Annual = per-session fee x 2 sessions (UTS full-time year = 48 credit points = 2 sessions of 24 credit points; UTS course pages state '1 year = 48 credit points'). Excludes SSAF and OSHC. UTS course pages show domestic fees only and the international fee search (cis.uts.edu.au/fees/course-fees.cfm) is a form that could not be queried; only the current (2027) summary tables are published at a fixed URL, so no 2024 or 2025 international fee was found and there is no feeHistory. City campus (Ultimo). The table lists one row for the BE (Honours); majors are not priced separately. 2024-2026 still unfilled (2026-10-13, unofficial search): Uni Enrol's 'UTS Fees & Courses In 2026' article (Feb 2026) gives per-year figures labelled 2026 that sit about 9.2% below UTS's own 2027 table for almost every course, while Hotcourses lists figures about 4.5% below 2027 under 2027 intakes, so the Uni Enrol figures look like 2025 fees mislabelled as 2026 and were not used; the cis.uts.edu.au fee search offers 2026 but could not be queried, and no agent mirror of an earlier UTS course summary table was found.
